ThingDef.label: chocolope
ThingDef.description: Engineered for chocolate production, the chocolope grows a large sac of cholocate's flavor chemicals on its back. It can be milked to produce chocolate.

ThingDef.label: devilope
ThingDef.description: Engineered for devilstrand production, as secondary effect the devilope grows a large sac of mushrooms on its back. It can be milked to produce mushrooms.

ThingDef.label: jellope
ThingDef.description: Engineered for insect jelly production, the jellope grows a large sac of insect jelly on its back. It can be milked to produce jelly insect.

ThingDef.label: neutroalope
ThingDef.description: Engineered for chemicals production, the neutrolope grows a large sac of chemicals on its back. It can be milked to produce neutraomine.

ThingDef.label: megaboomalope
ThingDef.description: Engineered for chemicals production, the MegaBoomalope grows a large sac of volatile chemicals on its back. Has been healed from his Luciferium adiction by a ecoterrorist organization. Other animals have learned to avoid it because of the huge explosion it produces when it dies. It can be milked to produce chemfuel - very carefully.

ThingDef.label: megaluciferope
ThingDef.description: Engineered for chemicals production, the boomalope grows a large sac of volatile chemicals on its back. Though it is weak and fragile for its size, other animals have learned to avoid it because of the huge explosion it produces when it dies. It can be milked to produce chemfuel - very carefully.
